summary.text: The light of wisdom is the radiance rank nine Wisdom Gu gives off. It pushes thought count, thinking speed, and thought collisions to their limit while burning lifespan.

claims.text: When rank nine Wisdom Gu is exposed among Eighty-Eight True Yang Building’s supreme true inheritances, it gives off the light of wisdom. Basking in this light, lifeforms lose lifespan rapidly while thoughts are created and destroyed in their minds, collide, and spark wisdom. The light of wisdom increases the number of thoughts to the limit, raises thinking speed to the limit, and makes collisions occur at the most rapid rate, greatly reducing time needed to think. That is Wisdom Gu’s true effect. Under the light, Giant Sun’s will is snapped because its thoughts expand and are destroyed without new thoughts regenerating as they would in a living mind.

Standing in the light of wisdom, Fang Yuan feels his lifespan decreasing unceasingly, yet the light is also the bane of Giant Sun’s will and keeps that will from chasing him while he remains in range.
